**VERDICT: REJECT**

The proposed bound 2x − 4 is most likely not the tight bound. My recollection of the literature on 4-contractible edges in 4-connected plane triangulations is that the sharp bound is **2x + 4**, where x = |V_{≥5}|, not 2x − 4. I did not verify this against the source or derive it from scratch, so treat that recollection as the basis for the verdict.

A quick check of the proposed formula also shows it is too weak to be tight in the small cases. For x = 2 it gives 0, but a 4-connected triangulation with two degree-5 vertices and five degree-4 vertices (n = 7) seems to have several 4-contractible edges, so the true minimum is likely above 0.

CONFIDENCE: 3
